name: NeoFreeBird
subtitle: A modified Twitter app, with branding reverts, BHTwitter and other QoL modifications.

apps.name: Twitter
apps.subtitle: NeoFreeBird version 6.2.0
apps.localizedDescription: NeoFreeBird-BHTwitter, changed to look like the app before the rebrand.

versions.localizedDescription:
Version 6.2.0
- Added an option to hide Blue checkmark tweets
- Added an option to hide the “Create Tweet” button
- Fixed Twitter rebranding in French

Version 6.1.3
Added a contributors section to the NeoFreeBird settings menu.

privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Enjoy the X experience tailored to your location.

privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Going forward, whenever you choose to share captions on this device, Apple will provide the service. Doing so helps make sure people of all hearing abilities can access your content.
privacy.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This helps X show you more relevant ads.
